text: threadPane.releaseSelection restores with notify false. restoreSelection then sets the underlying selection currentIndex and updates its classes instead of calling threadTree.currentIndex. The widget setter always scrolls a valid row into view. Preserve this difference between bookkeeping and visible navigation: disabling smooth scrolling still scrolls, while the direct path avoids it. The historical test changed sort setup but added no direct scroll-position assertion.
title: Release a temporary message selection without invoking the scrolling setter
